es-age-be.text: Don't say, I have twenty years. Say, I am twenty years old.
In English, we use be for age, not have.
Repeat after me. I am twenty years old.
Now ask a friend. How old are you?

hi-good-name.text: Don't say, what is your good name? Say, what is your name?
Good name sounds strange to many English speakers.
To be extra polite, say, may I have your name, please?
Repeat after me. May I have your name, please?

pt_BR-people-are.text: Repeat after me. People are nice here.

pt_BR-actually.text: Actually means in fact. Actually, I love rainy days.
